japanese-kana.swsh: ふしぎな　ちからで おたがいの　ばの　こうかを　いれかえる。

korean.swsh: 이상한 힘으로 서로의 필드 효과를 교체한다.

traditional-chinese.swsh: 用神奇的力量 與對手交換場地效果。

french.swsh: Une force mystérieuse intervertit les effets affectant chaque côté du terrain.

german.swsh: Durch eine mysteriöse Macht werden wirksame Effekte auf Mitstreiterseite und gegnerischer Seite getauscht.

spanish.swsh: Extraño poder que intercambia los efectos en el terreno de combate de ambos bandos.

italian.swsh: Una forza misteriosa inverte gli effetti attivi sul campo alleato e sul campo avversario.

english.swsh: With its mysterious power, the user swaps the effects on either side of the field.
english.la: With its mysterious power, the user swaps the effects on either side of the field.
english.sv: With its mysterious power, the user swaps the effects on either side of the field.

japanese.swsh: 不思議な　力で お互いの　場の　効果を　入れ替える。

simplified-chinese.swsh: 用神奇的力量 交换双方的场地效果。

latin-american-spanish.swsh: Extraño poder que intercambia los efectos en el terreno de combate de ambos bandos.

effect.full: Switches the Mist, Light Screen, Reflect, Spikes, Safeguard, Tailwind, Toxic Spikes, Stealth Rock, Water Pledge, Fire Pledge, Grass Pledge, Sticky Web, Aurora Veil, G-Max Steelsurge, G-Max Cannonade, G-Max Vine Lash, and G-Max Wildfire effects from the user's side to the opposing side and vice versa.
effect.shortEffect: Switches single sided field effects from the users side to the targets side and vice versa.
